english.title: Make a false statement to obtain PSV operator's licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly made a false statement, namely **(..SPECIFY STATEMENT..), for the purpose of

(A)_[obtaining the grant of]_
(B)_[obtaining the variation of]_
(C)_[preventing the grant of]_
(D)_[preventing the variation of]_
(E)_[procuring the imposition of a condition or limitation, namely **(..SPECIFY CONDITION OR LIMITATION..) in relation to]_

a licence under Part II of the Public Passenger Vehicles Act 1981 to

(F)_[yourself]_
(G)_[another person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 66(a) of the Public Passenger Vehicles Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
knowingly made a false statement for the purpose of
obtaining the grant of a licence under Part II of the Public Passenger Vehicles Act 1981 OR
obtaining the variation of such a licence OR
preventing the grant or variation of such a licence OR
procuring the imposition of a condition or limitation in relation to any such licence
to yourself / other person
